steps.name: repo-tooling-sync
steps.description: third_party/repo-tooling is byte-identical to dist/ at dependencies/repo-tooling.sha (repo-tooling built-in)

steps.name: provider-kit
steps.description: Vendored bootstrap, Rust crate and lib-auth-modules match lib-vistoda-provider-kit at the pin byte-for-byte and by tree digest (dependencies/vendored.json); fetches the pinned commit into .ci/vistoda-provider-kit

steps.name: provider-kit-test
steps.description: The provider kit's own lifecycle test, run from the checkout at the pinned commit
steps.run: pin=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < dependencies/vistoda-provider-kit.sha); kit=.ci/vistoda-provider-kit; test "$(git -C "$kit" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$pin" || { echo "$kit is not checked out at $pin; remove it and rerun" >&2; exit 1; }; test -z "$(git -C "$kit" status --porcelain)"; sh "$kit/tests/bootstrap-test.sh"

steps.name: release-check
steps.description: Cargo and Docker versions agree; immutable-image publication preflight

steps.name: secret-scan
steps.description: gitleaks 8.30.1 over the full git history

steps.name: loc
steps.description: fleet-default preset: 400-line limit, zero growth, ratchet (scripts/loc-baseline.json)

steps.name: source-languages
steps.description: Rust-only product: no Python sources outside vendored trees
steps.run: found=$(find . \( -path ./.git -o -path ./.ci -o -path ./target -o -path ./third_party -o -path ./vendor \) -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.py' \) -print); if [ -n "$found" ]; then echo "non-Rust sources are not allowed:" >&2; echo "$found" >&2; exit 1; fi

steps.name: rust-clippy
steps.description: clippy, all targets and features, warnings denied

steps.name: ci-local-jobs
steps.description: Every manifest step runs in exactly one CI job (tests/ci_local_jobs.rs)
